scanNote: 3-mashqda OLTI ko'rsatma berilgan, lekin rasmlardan FAQAT BESHTASI aniq o'qildi (Andy — 2 ta, Mary — 3 ta). 'receive an invitation' ko'rsatmasiga mos rasm bizdagi skanda topilmadi. Andyning pastki ikki rasmi (mashina kapoti ochiq + jarima yozayotgan yo'l nazoratchisi) BIRGALIKDA 'have problems with your car' ni bildiradi — nazoratchi alohida ko'rsatma emas. Buni taxmin bilan to'ldirmadim.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and match them to the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va ularni quyidagi ko'rsatmalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI KO'RSATMA:
  • pick some flowers        (gul termoq)
  • have a picnic in the park (parkda piknik
                               qilmoq)
  • fix his car              (mashinasini
                              tuzatmoq)
  • play football            (futbol o'ynamoq)
  • make some fresh orange juice
                             (yangi apelsin
                              sharbati tayyorlamoq)
  • take some photographs    (surat olmoq)


OLTI RASM:
  A  Oq gullar orasidagi ayol
  B  Kapoti ochiq mashina, yonida erkak
  C  Fotoapparatli ayol, orqada qadimiy ustunlar
  D  Keksa er-xotin, it va savat bilan maysazorda
  E  Bola, qo'lini TO'PGA qo'yib o'tiribdi
  F  Bozor/do'konda meva ushlab turgan ayol


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  A  →  pick some flowers          (NAMUNA)
  B  →  fix his car
  C  →  take some photographs
  D  →  have a picnic in the park
  E  →  play football
  F  →  make some fresh orange juice


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  A  Ayol gullar orasida turibdi → GUL TERMOQ.
     Kitob buni namuna qilib bergan.

  B  Mashinaning KAPOTI OChIQ va erkak unga
     engashgan → MAShINANI TUZATMOQ.

  C  Ayolning qo'lida FOTOAPPARAT, orqada
     tarixiy ustunlar → SURAT OLMOQ.

  D  Keksa er-xotin maysazorda, ayolning qo'lida
     SAVAT, yonida it → PARKDA PIKNIK.

  E  Bola qo'lini oq-qora TO'PGA qo'yib o'tiribdi
     → FUTBOL O'YNAMOQ.

  F  Ayol bozorda/do'konda meva ushlab turibdi →
     APELSIN ShARBATI tayyorlamoq.


DIQQAT — 'FIX' va 'MAKE':
  'FIX a car'  = mashinani TUZATMOQ (buzilganini)
  'MAKE juice' = sharbat TAYYORLAMOQ (yangidan)
  Ikkalasi ham o'zbekchada 'qilmoq' bo'lishi
  mumkin, lekin ingliz tilida BOShQA fe'llar.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to pick flowers = gul termoq
  a picnic        = piknik
  to fix          = tuzatmoq
  fresh           = yangi, tetik
  a photograph    = surat (= a photo)

pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Ayol gullar orasida turibdi.
'to pick flowers' = gul termoq.

Mashinaning KAPOTI OCHIQ va erkak unga
engashgan → nosozlikni tuzatmoqchi.
'to fix' = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq.
DIQQAT: 'HIS car' — erkak, shuning uchun 'he'.

Ayolning qo'lida FOTOAPPARAT, orqada tarixiy
ustunlar (diqqatga sazovor joy).
'TAKE photographs' = surat olmoq
('make photographs' XATO).

pairs.right: have a picnic in the park
pairs.leftUz: Keksa er-xotin, it va savat bilan maysazorda
pairs.whyUz:
Ayolning qo'lida PIKNIK SAVATI, ular
maysazorda, yonlarida it.
'HAVE a picnic' = piknik qilmoq.
DIQQAT: IKKI kishi → 'THEY are going to'.

Bolaning qo'li ostida oq-qora FUTBOL TO'PI
ko'rinadi → futbol o'ynamoqchi.
'PLAY football' — sport oldidan artikl YO'Q.

Ayol bozorda meva ushlab turibdi →
sharbat uchun apelsin olmoqda.
'MAKE juice' = sharbat tayyorlamoq.
'fresh' = yangi, tetik.

exercises.instructionEn: Then say what the people are going to do, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng odamlar nima qilmoqchi ekanini ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'She'S GOING TO pick some flowers. (Picture A)'


QOLIP:
  ega + IS/ARE GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .
  (Picture X)


ENG MUHIM — OLMOShNI TO'G'RI TANLASh:

  A  ayol       →  SHE'S going to
  B  erkak      →  HE'S going to
  C  ayol       →  SHE'S going to
  D  IKKI kishi →  THEY'RE going to
  E  bola       →  HE'S going to
  F  ayol       →  SHE'S going to

  DIQQAT: faqat D da KO'PLIK (er-xotin) →
  'THEY ARE' ('They're').


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  A  She's going to pick some flowers.  (NAMUNA)
  B  He's going to fix his car.
  C  She's going to take some photographs.
  D  They're going to have a picnic in the park.
  E  He's going to play football.
  F  She's going to make some fresh orange juice.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  A  U gul termoqchi.
  B  U mashinasini tuzatmoqchi.
  C  U surat olmoqchi.
  D  Ular parkda piknik qilishmoqchi.
  E  U futbol o'ynamoqchi.
  F  U yangi apelsin sharbati tayyorlamoqchi.


NEGA 'BE GOING TO':
  Rasmda odamlar ishni BOShLAMAGAN — ular
  TAYYORGARLIK ko'rmoqda.
  Bu — NIYAT (Coursebook 94-betdagi 7-mashq
  bilan bir xil mantiq).

  Agar ular ishni BAJARAYOTGAN bo'lsa,
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS bo'lardi:
     'She IS PICKING some flowers.'

modelSentences.sentence: She's going to pick some flowers.
He's going to fix his car.
She's going to take some photographs.

modelSentences.word: D  have a picnic in the park
modelSentences.sentence: They're going to have a picnic in the park.

modelSentences.uz: U futbol o'ynamoqchi. (sport oldidan artikl YO'Q)

modelSentences.word: F  make some fresh orange juice
modelSentences.sentence: She's going to make some fresh orange juice.
modelSentences.uz: U yangi apelsin sharbati tayyorlamoqchi. ('MAKE juice')

exercises.instructionEn: What are they going to do? Match column A to column B.
exercises.instructionUz: Ular nima qilishmoqchi? A ustunni B ustunga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
USTUN A (holat / xohish):
  1  Joe doesn't like working at the cafe
  2  Richard needs to lose weight
  3  Sally wants to pass her exams
  4  David has got a new job in Paris
  5  Tina wants a nice suntan
  6  Lucy likes dancing

USTUN B (harakat):
  a  study really hard
  b  sunbathe in the garden
  c  take ballet lessons
  d  find another job
  e  start French lessons
  f  join a gym


Kitob BIRINChISINI chizib bergan: 1 → d


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  →  d   find another job
  2  →  f   join a gym
  3  →  a   study really hard
  4  →  e   start French lessons
  5  →  b   sunbathe in the garden
  6  →  c   take ballet lessons


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — SABAB → HARAKAT:

  1  Kafedagi ish yoqmaydi → BOShQA ISh topish
  2  Vazn tashlash kerak → SPORT ZALIGA a'zo
     bo'lish
  3  Imtihonlardan o'tmoqchi → QATTIQ O'QISh
  4  PARIJDA yangi ish → FRANSUZ TILI darslari
     (Parij — Fransiya poytaxti)
  5  Chiroyli QORAYISh xohlaydi → QUYOShDA
     TOBLANISh
  6  Raqsni yaxshi ko'radi → BALET darslari


ENG OSON BAND — 4:
  'a new job in PARIS' va 'start FRENCH lessons'
  — Parij Fransiyada, demak fransuz tili kerak.
  ANIQ bog'liqlik. Shu banddan boshlang.


DIQQAT — 2 va 6-BANDLAR ALDAMChI EMAS:
  'join a gym' vazn tashlash uchun (2),
  'take ballet lessons' raqs uchun (6).
  Balet ham sport, lekin 6-bandda 'likes DANCING'
  aniq aytilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  to pass exams  = imtihonlardan o'tmoq
  a suntan       = quyoshda qorayish
  to sunbathe    = quyoshda toblanmoq
  ballet         = balet
  another        = boshqa (yana bitta)

pairs.left: 1  Joe doesn't like working at the cafe
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA ChIZILGAN.
Ish yoqmasa → BOSHQA ish topiladi.
'another' = boshqa (yana bitta).
'work AT a cafe' — predlog AT.

Vazn tashlash → SPORT bilan shug'ullanish.
'JOIN a gym' = sport zaliga A'ZO bo'lmoq.
Coursebook 93-betdagi Jennining xatida ham:
'join a gym TO LOSE some weight'.

pairs.left: 3  Sally wants to pass her exams
pairs.whyUz:
Imtihondan o'tish → QATTIQ o'qish.
'study HARD' = qattiq o'qimoq.
DIQQAT: 'hardly' — butunlay boshqa so'z
('deyarli emas').

pairs.left: 4  David has got a new job in Paris
pairs.whyUz:
ENG OSON BAND: PARIJ — Fransiya poytaxti,
demak FRANSUZ tili kerak.
ANIQ bog'liqlik — shu banddan boshlang.
Grammar 59-betdagi 9-mashqda ham shu juftlik.

Qorayish → QUYOSHDA toblanish.
'a suntan' = quyoshda qorayish.
'to sunbathe' = quyoshda toblanmoq
(sun + bathe).

Raqs → BALET darslari.
'likes DANCING' — 'like' dan keyin '-ing'.
'TAKE lessons' = dars olmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Joe doesn't like working at the cafe, SO HE IS
   GOING TO find another job.'


QOLIP:
  [SABAB], SO + ega + IS GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.
  'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi
  (Coursebook 95-bet, Grammar 57-bet).


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  1  Joe doesn't like working at the cafe, so he
     is going to find another job.       (NAMUNA)

  2  Richard needs to lose weight, so he is going
     to join a gym.

  3  Sally wants to pass her exams, so she is
     going to study really hard.

  4  David has got a new job in Paris, so he is
     going to start French lessons.

  5  Tina wants a nice suntan, so she is going to
     sunbathe in the garden.

  6  Lucy likes dancing, so she is going to take
     ballet lessons.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Joga kafedagi ish yoqmaydi, shuning uchun u
     boshqa ish topmoqchi.
  2  Richardga vazn tashlash kerak, shuning uchun
     u sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi.
  3  Salli imtihonlardan o'tmoqchi, shuning uchun
     u juda qattiq o'qimoqchi.
  4  Devidning Parijda yangi ishi bor, shuning
     uchun u fransuz tili darslarini boshlamoqchi.
  5  Tina chiroyli qoraymoqchi, shuning uchun u
     bog'da quyoshda toblanmoqchi.
  6  Lyusi raqsni yaxshi ko'radi, shuning uchun u
     balet darslariga bormoqchi.


OLMOShLAR:
  Joe, Richard, David  →  HE  is going to
  Sally, Tina, Lucy    →  SHE is going to

  Hammasi BIRLIK → 'IS going to'.


ESLATMA — 'BECAUSE' BILAN HAM AYTISh MUMKIN:
  'Joe is going to find another job BECAUSE he
   doesn't like working at the cafe.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat TARTIB teskari.

  Lekin kitob 'SO' ni so'ragan → SABAB birinchi,
  NATIJA ikkinchi.

  Grammar 59-betdagi 8-mashq bilan AYNAN bir xil
  tuzilish.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the prompts to the pictures. Then, say what the astrologist told Andy and Mary, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni rasmlarga moslang. So'ng munajjim Endi va Meriga nima deganini ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI KO'RSATMA:
  • go on a long journey        (uzoq safarga
                                 chiqmoq)
  • receive an invitation       (taklif olmoq)
  • argue with your best friend (eng yaqin do'st
                                 bilan janjallashmoq)
  • have problems with your health
                                (sog'liq muammosi)
  • have problems with your car (mashina muammosi)
  • celebrate something special (biror maxsus
                                 voqeani nishonlamoq)


RASMLAR:

  ANDY ustuni:
     1  Ikki erkak peshonama-peshona turib
        janjallashyapti
     2  Kapoti ochiq mashina, unga engashgan erkak
        + jarima yozayotgan yo'l nazoratchisi

  MARY ustuni:
     1  Stetoskopli shifokor ayolni ko'rikdan
        o'tkazyapti
     2  Ikki qadah bir-biriga urilmoqda
     3  Ochiq chamadon, ichida narsalar joylangan


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  ANDY:
     • argue with your best friend
       (ikki erkak janjallashyapti)
     • have problems with your car
       (mashina + jarima)

  MARY:
     • have problems with your health
       (shifokor ko'rigi)
     • celebrate something special
       (qadahlar urilmoqda)
     • go on a long journey
       (joylangan chamadon)


⚠ HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh:
  Oltinchi ko'rsatma — 'RECEIVE AN INVITATION' —
  ga mos rasm bizdagi skanda TOPILMADI.

  Andyning pastki ikki tasviri (mashina va
  nazoratchi) BIRGALIKDA bitta ma'noni beradi:
  mashina buzildi va jarima yozildi →
  'have problems with your car'.
  Nazoratchi ALOHIDA ko'rsatma emas — u pochtachi
  yoki taklif keltiruvchi emas (kepkasida nishon,
  yelkasida tasma, qo'lida jarima daftari).

  Shuning uchun bu bandni taxmin bilan
  to'ldirmadim.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Andy, you WILL ARGUE with your best friend.
   You will also ...'


QOLIP:
  [Ism], you WILL + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .
  You will ALSO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .

  DIQQAT: munajjim bashorat qilyapti → 'WILL'
  (Coursebook 95-bet: bashorat uchun 'will').
  Coursebook 96-betdagi 12 bashorat ham hammasi
  'will' bilan edi.


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

  ANDY:
     'Andy, you will argue with your best friend.
      You will also have problems with your car.'

  MARY:
     'Mary, you will have problems with your
      health. You will also celebrate something
      special and go on a long journey.'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Endi, sen eng yaqin do'sting bilan
  janjallashasan. Shuningdek, mashinang bilan
  muammoing bo'ladi.

  Meri, sening sog'lig'ingda muammo bo'ladi.
  Shuningdek, biror maxsus voqeani nishonlaysan
  va uzoq safarga chiqasan.


DIQQAT — 'ALSO' NING O'RNI:
  'You will ALSO have problems ...'
  'also' — 'will' dan KEYIN, asosiy fe'ldan
  OLDIN.
  'You also will ...' — kamroq tabiiy.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an astrologist  = munajjim
  to receive      = olmoq
  to argue with   = ... bilan janjallashmoq
  to celebrate    = nishonlamoq
  a journey       = safar (uzoq)

pairs.leftUz: Ikki erkak jahl bilan bir-biriga qarab turibdi
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
'Andy, you will ARGUE WITH YOUR BEST FRIEND.'
Rasmda ikki erkak jahl bilan peshonama-peshona
turibdi.
'argue WITH sb' — predlog WITH.

pairs.left: ANDY — kapoti ochiq mashina + jarima yozayotgan nazoratchi
pairs.leftUz: Erkak mashina kapotiga engashgan; yonida formali nazoratchi jarima yozyapti
pairs.whyUz:
IKKI tasvir BIRGALIKDA bitta ma'noni beradi:
mashina buzildi VA jarima yozildi.

Nazoratchi ALOHIDA ko'rsatma emas —
kepkasida nishon, yelkasida tasma, qo'lida
jarima daftari (pochtachi emas).

'have problems WITH sth' — predlog WITH.

pairs.leftUz: Shifokor stetoskop bilan ayolni ko'rikdan o'tkazyapti
pairs.whyUz:
Shifokor va stetoskop → SOG'LIQ.
Coursebook 96-betdagi Capricorn va Pisces
bashoratlarida ham aynan shu ibora bor edi:
'You'll have problems with your HEALTH.'

Qadahlarni urish → NIShONLASh belgisi.
'to celebrate' = nishonlamoq.
Coursebook 93-betdagi xatda ham:
'a garden party TO CELEBRATE Richard's
birthday'.

pairs.left: MARY — ochiq chamadon, ichida narsalar joylangan
pairs.leftUz: Ochiq chamadon, dastasi va ichida joylangan narsalar
pairs.whyUz:
JOYLANGAN ChAMADON → uzoq safar.
'go ON a journey' — predlog ON.
DIQQAT: 'a journey' — UZOQ safar
('a trip' — qisqa sayohat).

pairs.rightUz: Bizdagi skanda bu ko'rsatmaga mos rasm yo'q
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ HALOL OGOHLANTIRISh.
Olti ko'rsatmadan BESHTASI rasmlarga aniq
mos keldi. 'receive an invitation' ga mos
rasm topilmadi.

Andyning nazoratchisi pochtachi emas (jarima
daftari, nishon, tasma) — shuning uchun uni
'taklif olmoq' deb belgilash NOTO'G'RI bo'lardi.

Taxmin bilan to'ldirmadim.

exercises.instructionEn: Jill is going to have a barbecue in her garden. Write sentences about what she is/isn't going to buy, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Jill bog'ida barbekyu qilmoqchi. U nima sotib olmoqchi va nima olmoqchi emasligi haqida gaplar yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ MAHSULOT — har birida ✓ yoki ✗ belgisi:

     a  biscuits   ✗   (pechenye)
     b  onions     ✓   (piyoz)
     c  meat       ✓   (go'sht)
     d  pizza      ✗   (pitsa)
     e  chicken    ✓   (tovuq)
     f  bread      ✓   (non)
     g  eggs       ✗   (tuxum)
     h  potatoes   ✗   (kartoshka)

  OLADI (✓):     b, c, e, f  — onions, meat,
                              chicken, bread
  OLMAYDI (✗):   a, d, g, h  — biscuits, pizza,
                              eggs, potatoes


BARCHA SAKKIZ GAP:

  a  She isn't going to buy any biscuits.
  b  She's going to buy some onions.
  c  She's going to buy some meat.
  d  She isn't going to buy any pizza.
  e  She's going to buy some chicken.
  f  She's going to buy some bread.
  g  She isn't going to buy any eggs.
  h  She isn't going to buy any potatoes.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  a  U pechenye sotib olmoqchi emas.
  b  U piyoz sotib olmoqchi.
  c  U go'sht sotib olmoqchi.
  d  U pitsa sotib olmoqchi emas.
  e  U tovuq sotib olmoqchi.
  f  U non sotib olmoqchi.
  g  U tuxum sotib olmoqchi emas.
  h  U kartoshka sotib olmoqchi emas.


ENG MUHIM — 'SOME' va 'ANY':

  TASDIQ gapda   →  SOME
     'She's going to buy SOME onions.'

  INKOR gapda    →  ANY
     'She isn't going to buy ANY biscuits.'

  Bu — Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') qoidasi,
  bu yerda takrorlanmoqda.


QOLIP:
  ✓  She'S GOING TO buy SOME + ot.
  ✗  She ISN'T GOING TO buy ANY + ot.

  DIQQAT: 'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN
  ('is not' → 'isn't').


OTLARNING TURI — DIQQAT:

  SANALADIGAN (ko'plikda):
     biscuits, onions, eggs, potatoes

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     meat, chicken, bread
     ('a meat', 'a bread' XATO)

  IKKALASI HAM BO'LADI:
     pizza — butun pitsa bo'lsa 'a pizza'
             (sanaladigan), umuman ovqat sifatida
             'pizza' (sanalmaydigan)
     Bu yerda umumiy ma'noda → 'ANY pizza'.

  DIQQAT: 'some' va 'any' IKKALA turda ham
  ishlatiladi — shuning uchun bu mashqda
  chalkashish yo'q.


NEGA ShU MAHSULOTLAR — BARBEKYU MANTIQI:

  OLADI:
     go'sht va tovuq — barbekyuda pishiriladi
     piyoz — go'sht bilan
     non — go'sht bilan yeyiladi

  OLMAYDI:
     pechenye, pitsa — barbekyuga mos emas
     tuxum, kartoshka — uyda bor bo'lsa kerak


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a barbecue = barbekyu (ochiq havoda go'sht
               pishirish)
  biscuits   = pechenye (Amerikada: cookies)
  an onion   = piyoz
  meat       = go'sht (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  chicken    = tovuq (SANALMAYDIGAN — go'sht
               sifatida)
  bread      = non (SANALMAYDIGAN)

items.answer: She isn't going to buy any biscuits.
items.whyUz:
✗ → INKOR gap → 'ANY'.
'She ISN'T going to buy ANY biscuits.'
'biscuits' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik).
DIQQAT: inkor gapda 'some' EMAS, 'any'.

items.answer: She's going to buy some onions.
items.whyUz:
✓ → TASDIQ gap → 'SOME'.
'She'S going to buy SOME onions.'
'onions' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik).
Piyoz barbekyuda go'sht bilan ishlatiladi.

items.answer: She's going to buy some meat.
items.whyUz:
✓ → TASDIQ gap → 'SOME'.
'meat' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot
('a meat' yoki 'meats' XATO).
Barbekyuning asosiy mahsuloti.

items.answer: She isn't going to buy any pizza.
items.whyUz:
✗ → INKOR gap → 'ANY'.
'pizza' bu yerda umumiy ovqat ma'nosida →
SANALMAYDIGAN.
Pitsa barbekyuga mos emas.

items.answer: She's going to buy some chicken.
items.whyUz:
✓ → TASDIQ gap → 'SOME'.
'chicken' go'sht sifatida — SANALMAYDIGAN.
DIQQAT: tirik tovuq bo'lsa 'A chicken'
(sanaladigan), go'sht bo'lsa 'chicken'.

items.answer: She's going to buy some bread.
items.whyUz:
✓ → TASDIQ gap → 'SOME'.
'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot
('a bread' XATO; 'a loaf of bread' deyiladi).
Grammar 59-bet, 11-mashqning 5-bandida ham
'a loaf of bread' bor edi.

items.answer: She isn't going to buy any eggs.
items.whyUz:
✗ → INKOR gap → 'ANY'.
'eggs' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik).
Tuxum barbekyuda ishlatilmaydi.

items.answer: She isn't going to buy any potatoes.
items.whyUz:
✗ → INKOR gap → 'ANY'.
'potatoes' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik).
DIQQAT: KO'PLIK '-ES' bilan:
potato → potatoES (tomato → tomatoES ham).

items.derivedUz: She's going to buy SOME onions.
She isn't going to buy ANY biscuits.
Is she going to buy any bread?
She's going to pick some flowers.
He's going to fix his car.
They're going to have a picnic.

items.derived: have a party, have a barbecue

patterns.formula: ega + IS/ARE GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .
patterns.exampleEn: She's going to pick some flowers. They're going to have a picnic in the park.
patterns.exampleUz: U gul termoqchi. Ular parkda piknik qilishmoqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
REJA va NIYAT.
Olmoshni to'g'ri tanlang: bir kishi → he's/she's,
ikki kishi → they're.

patterns.formula: [SABAB], SO + ega + IS GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Joe doesn't like working at the cafe, so he is going to find another job.
patterns.exampleUz: Joga kafedagi ish yoqmaydi, shuning uchun u boshqa ish topmoqchi.

patterns.formula: She'S GOING TO buy SOME + ot.   /   She ISN'T GOING TO buy ANY + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: She's going to buy some onions. She isn't going to buy any biscuits.
patterns.exampleUz: U piyoz sotib olmoqchi. U pechenye sotib olmoqchi emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
TASDIQ → SOME, INKOR → ANY.
'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN ('isn't').

patterns.formula: [Ism], you WILL + fe'l ... . You will ALSO + fe'l ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Andy, you will argue with your best friend. You will also have problems with your car.
patterns.exampleUz: Endi, sen eng yaqin do'sting bilan janjallashasan. Shuningdek, mashinang bilan muammoing bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Munajjim BASHORAT qilyapti → 'WILL'.
'also' — 'will' dan KEYIN, fe'ldan OLDIN.
